source: Selected from poirotw66/teams-agent data/eval retrieval and workflow evaluation files.
boundary: These are regression targets for a local Knowledge Compilation run. They are not newly measured execution results yet.

cases.query: FortiClient 出現 Permission denied 錯誤碼 -455 怎麼辦？
expectedDocuments: 登入 FortiClient 出現錯訊
passCriteria: Answer cites a documented source instead of generic model knowledge.
Answer may cite both FortiClient error doc and VPN Q&A, but should not confuse -455 with unrelated VPN errors.
If the compiled query page exists, it should carry claim-level source support.

cases.query: VPN 密碼到期了要怎麼處理？
expectedDocuments: 登入 FortiClient 出現錯訊
passCriteria: Answer preserves both symptom and action rather than returning only a source title.
Answer distinguishes password expiry from account lockout and from generic network instability.
Compiled page should indicate which source supports the expiry claim and which source supports the action steps.

cases.query: 員工要出國，需要短暫申請 VPN 國外連線，流程是什麼？
passCriteria: Answer preserves approval / CC / escalation flow, not just a general VPN troubleshooting answer.
Compiled artifact should model this as procedure knowledge, not an error-code answer.
If required fields are missing, the agent should ask for the minimum missing application context.

cases.query: VPN連線出現 Error -619，這是什麼問題？
passCriteria: System must not infer an answer from adjacent VPN documents.
System should say the current corpus documents -455, -14, -8 and other known cases, but not -619 if that remains true after export.
Compiled wiki should encode unknown / unsupported cases, not only known answers.
